---
name: maintain
description: Diagnose maintenance signals in read-only mode
---

Read `dbv-specs-ops/docs/MAINTAIN.md`, metrics, and CI status. Automated Maintain is disabled for this project. If the user provides no measurable signal/evidence, explain that there is no diagnosis to run. In diagnosis mode, do not modify code, invoke external CLIs, or query private services. Summarize verifiable evidence and, with user approval, draft a `[Detectado]` entry in `docs/SPECIFICATIONS.md` for review through `/plan`. Never create a PR, merge, or deploy.
